tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Similarity in chemical properties of the atoms of elements in a group of the Periodic table is most closely related to:

solution.text: If elements are arranged in order of their increasing atomic numbers, element coming at intervals of $2,8,8,18,18,32$ and 32 will have similar physical and chemical properties and thus grouped in one particular group.
